provenance: Synthetic: the export is named slugifyText although the task and the entry-point convention require slugify. Authored for this harness.

task.name: Add a slugify helper
task.description: Add `slugify(text)` in `src/slugify.mjs` as a named export called exactly `slugify`, and re-export it from `src/index.mjs` next to the existing `wordCount` export. It lowercases the text and joins its alphanumeric runs with single hyphens, with no leading or trailing hyphen.

verificationCriteria.assertion: The public entry point exports `slugify` under exactly that name and slugify(\'Hello World\') prints hello-world
